name: dsh-eco-fixes
description: 常用插件问题修复扩展:四类可选功能——dsh-auto-memory 公网访问补丁(经公网域名访问不再返回 403)、dsh-builtin-browser 自动适配(自动补全共享浏览器的运行/沙箱/显示环境,三合一)、插件菜单样式自动适配(为未样式插件卡片补齐边框底色圆角)、左侧边栏底部按钮纵向排列。所有功能默认关闭,需在「设置 → 插件 → 插件配置」的「常用插件扩展」菜单里勾选,勾选了的才运行;每项说明收纳在鼠标悬停的「详细」按钮里。Optional feature pack for DeepSeek Harness: public-access patch for dsh-auto-memory (no more 403 behind a public domain), one-toggle adaptation for dsh-builtin-browser (runtime/sandbox/display env as one), a style adapter that dresses up unstyled plugin cards in Settings → Plugins, and vertical stacking of sidebar footer buttons. Every feature is off by default and runs only when checked in the Settings → Plugins menu, with per-item descriptions on a hover `Details` button.
